gripOrHq.title: Finders Keepers
gripOrHq.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Chiba Bank Account
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Invisibility
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Synchronized Attack on HQ
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. For each card stored in HQ, the Corp either pays [2] or discards that card.

heapOrArchives.title: Cloak
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Cloak when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Vewy Vewy Quiet
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Vewy Vewy Quiet when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Swiss Bank Account
rig.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

root.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

root.title: Experimental AI
root.rulesText: You may advance Experimental AI before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Experimental AI, trash one program for each advancement counter on it.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

setAside.title: Rent-I-Con
setAside.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength
